d:
"Hum Hai Banaras Ke Bhaiya" is a full-on celebration of friendship, swagger, and small-town attitude from "Kohram" (1999). Bringing together two powerhouse performers, Amitabh Bachchan and Nana Patekar, this track is all about the kind of bond where words aren't needed and the dosti speaks for itself.
Hum Hai Banaras Ke Bhaiya | Kohram | Amitabh Bachchan Nana Patekar Dosti Anthem | Amit K, Sudesh B
Song: Hum Hai Banaras Ke Bhaiya
Movie: Kohram (1999)
Star Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Nana Patekar, Mukul Dev, Ayesha Jhulka, Tabu
Singers: Amit Kumar, Sudesh Bhosle
